ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. No class on Nov. 23 (fall break). In addition to the online sessions, four labs will be held. These will be at two locations: Morton Arboretum in Lisle, IL (Aug. 28 from 9-1pm and Oct. 9 from 9-1pm) and at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign campus (Sept. 25 from10am to 2 pm; Nov. 1 from 10-2pm).
